text: Co-founder. A community initiative for open Arabic NLP research, producing tools, datasets, and models with contributors worldwide.
Arabic tokenization library implementing word, SentencePiece, character, disjoint-letter, and randomized segmentation. Part of ARBML.
Crowdsourced catalogue of Arabic datasets, the largest of its kind. Part of ARBML.
NLP application for Arabic prosody, built for the Barmajan Hackathon. Part of ARBML.
Structured-data harvesting framework built on Scrapy; the *Ashaar* Arabic poetry dataset is one of its use cases. Part of ARBML.
Python wrapper for the Farasa Arabic NLP toolkit, widely adopted in the community.

Dot restoration for dotless Arabic (*rasm*): a 431M-word corpus with trained n-gram, BiLSTM, Transformer, and CANINE models, with a [Hugging Face demo](https://huggingface.co/spaces/KFUPM-JRCAI/tnqeet-app).
Anonymous, shareable links to Hugging Face models and datasets for double-blind peer review, streamed without server-side storage. [Source](https://github.com/MagedSaeed/anonymous-hf).
PyTorch package providing greedy and beam-search decoding for generative models.
